title: Borrowing Based on Great Expectations: Evidence from the Origins of Fracking
eligible_reason: The paper's own main specifications (Figures 3-5, Tables 5, A2, A4) interact an ever-leaseholder indicator with calendar-year dummies (lease_y2000-lease_y2019 = _treated x year) on a PSM-matched individual-quarter panel with individual and quarter FE; these are two-group-by-calendar-year event studies without unit-specific adoption dates and do not qualify. However, Figure 6 (the Cookson-Gilje-Heimer replication) estimates a Callaway-Sant'Anna event study with csdid in which the cohort variable grp equals the lease year (first lease payment year, 2001-2016) for leaseholders and 0 for matched non-leaseholders, so treatment switches on at unit-specific dates with many cohorts and a never-treated group. That reported CSA specification (no covariates, dripw) qualifies under the protocol's modern-estimator clause, and a TWFE counterpart with cell and year FE can be constructed. The data are proprietary (Equifax / NY Fed Consumer Credit Panel), so replication is infeasible from the package.
design_notes: Quarterly consumer-credit panel 2000-2019 of Barnett Shale (Texas) leaseholders matched by Equifax to the NY Fed CCP, plus propensity-score matched non-leaseholders. Main sample: 1:1 PSM without replacement on pre-period (2000-2002) characteristics, no leases before 2007 excluded ('nopre2007'), Dallas and absentee owners excluded. Main regressions: reghdfe total/mortgage/auto_total/other_debt on lease_y2000 ... lease_y2019 (ever-treated x year, 2002 omitted), absorb(cidnew newqtr), cluster(cidnew). Table 5: cross-sectional heterogeneity of individual DiD changes. Figure 6 (9_CGH_replication.do): treated restricted to four Barnett counties, PSM within 3-digit zip (psmatch2 with replacement, outcome total_payment), collapsed to year x grp x zip3new cells with cell counts as weights; csdid yearly_payment [weight=total_count], ivar(newid) time(year) gvar(grp) method(dripw) cluster(zip3new); estat event, window(-6 8). grp = lease_year (0 for untreated). Lease years in the CGH sample span 2001-2016 (mean 2007.9).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Lease years 2001-2016 in the CGH replication sample (from a commented summary in 9_CGH_replication.do: lease_year min 2001, max 2016); exact cohort count with both pre and post observations unknown.
preferred_spec_note: The CSA specification is a comparison with Cookson, Gilje and Heimer (JFE), not the paper's preferred estimate; the preferred specifications (Figures 3-5) are not eligible.

specs.outcome: yearly_payment (cell mean of annual total debt payments, 2010 dollars)
specs.treatment_var: grp (csdid gvar): cohort = lease_year for leaseholders, 0 for matched non-leaseholders
specs.treatment_definition: year of the individual's first gas lease (first payment); treatment on from that year
specs.fe: csdid cohort-time ATTs (TWFE counterpart: newid and year FE)
specs.weights: total_count (number of individuals in the cell)
specs.sample_condition: treated = leaseholders in Wise, Denton, Tarrant, Johnson counties with >= 80 quarters in CCP, acreage <= 15, not leased before entering CCP; controls = non-leaseholders PSM-matched within zip3 on riskscore and credit_length (with replacement); collapsed by year grp zip3new
specs.notes: Collapsed cell-level data; matching with replacement used only to select the control sample, weights are cell sizes.

specs.exclusion_reason: treatment indicators are ever-treated x calendar year, not unit-specific adoption dates
specs.treatment_var: lease_y2000 lease_y2001 lease_y2003 ... lease_y2019 (= _treated & year == y), 2002 omitted
specs.weights: none (aweight=_weight in replacement-matching robustness, Table A4)
specs.notes: Main-text figures are derived from this regression.

data_files_note: Only the Table 1 simulation spreadsheets are shipped. All credit-panel files (Equifax match to NY Fed CCP) are proprietary; access requires Fed collaboration. Lease data from Enverus are licensed. Code requires an HPC node with 500 GB RAM for steps 1-7.
software_notes: StataMP 18 (reghdfe, psmatch2, csdid, estout); R for Enverus lease processing; ArcMap for maps.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Eligible only through the Figure 6 CSA replication of CGH; whether Figure 6 is in the main text should be confirmed against the article (readme calls it 'figure 6 in the paper'). Without data access the paper cannot be re-estimated.
